A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same DEER research work, with 39 pages including Appendices A–I. Text, PDF-object, and rendered-page comparisons establish that substantive content is identical; only first-page publication dates, version labels, and associated metadata change.

before.justification: v3 reports original benchmark evaluations, comparisons with human judgments, and claim-extraction and verification experiments in Section 6 and Appendices E–H.

after.justification: v4 retains the same original empirical results, including system scores, human-evaluation correlations, and appendix backtracking and retrieval experiments.

M1.justification: The rubric-based evaluation, expert guidance, claim extraction, citation backtracking, and verification procedures remain identical in Section 4 and the appendices.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same 50 expert-report tasks across 13 domains and retain the same human-annotated and adversarial claim-verification scenarios.

E2.justification: Table 1 contains identical model and system comparisons. Table 15 retains the same sliding-window baselines with window sizes 5, 10, and 15; no comparator changes elsewhere.

E3.justification: Evaluation models, metrics, scoring rules, sample selection, and testing procedures are unchanged. This includes the 45-report, 90-rating human evaluation in Appendix H and the claim-verification settings in Appendices E–F.

E4.justification: The component ablations, domain analysis, citation-backtracking comparison, and retrieval sensitivity and adversarial analyses are identical, including Figure 3 and Tables 2–5 and 15–16.

E5.justification: Table 2 retains the same mean and standard-deviation reporting across five evaluator models. Agreement and reliability calculations are unchanged, with no added or revised run-count or uncertainty disclosures.

E6.justification: All numerical results and qualitative findings match, including appendix results. For example, OpenAI (deep) retains a mean of 6.49 in Table 1, and backtracking retains a Jaccard score of 0.7070 in Table 15.

T1.justification: The citation-set definition in Equation 1, aggregation equations in Appendix D, and backtracking and metric definitions in Appendix F are identical. No assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain identical claims about DEER's taxonomy, expert guidance, report-wide verification, and diagnostic usefulness.

C2.justification: Interpretations of report-quality weaknesses, expert guidance, and retrieval accuracy–cost tradeoffs remain unchanged. Both versions state the same limitations concerning LLM judges and text-based reports.

D1.justification: Implementation details, model configurations, evaluation costs, prompts, and code-access information are unchanged in Section 5 and the appendices.

R1.justification: The cited works, reference list, and research positioning in Section 2 and Appendix A are identical, including the benchmark and verification-pipeline comparisons.

P1.justification: The first-page preprint date changes from February 4 to March 11, 2026, and the arXiv stamp changes from v3 dated February 3 to v4 dated March 10, 2026. All research prose, terminology, headings, and document structure remain identical.

P2.justification: Figures, tables, captions, and document layout are unchanged. Pages 2–39 render identically; first-page visual differences are confined to the updated date and version text.

improvement.justification: v4 updates publication dates and version metadata without changing the paper's methods, evidence, explanations, limitations, or substantive presentation. Comparison of the complete main text and appendices establishes no meaningful difference in overall quality.
